subject: infra.connect
name: National radio frequency plan and spectrum allocation table
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's published national frequency allocation table, or the order approving it, which would settle what spectrum is assigned to whom and at what price

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G spectrum award or licensing plan
what_would_settle_it: A regulator licence award, a tender notice or a ministerial statement of policy; the base holds only a 2024 international statement that no such network exists and a 2024 ministerial request to a supplier for a platform for the state operator

subject: infra.connect
name: Universal service fund
what_would_settle_it: The decree or law creating a universal-service fund and its annual accounts, or a ministerial statement that none exists; the base holds no Chad-specific statement either way

subject: infra.connect
name: Fibre kilometres laid and masts erected under the connectivity programme
what_would_settle_it: A programme progress report or ministry reception minute stating delivery against the 1,200 km and 200-mast targets; the only delivery-side number in the base is the 1,275 km cited in an ultimatum, which no source reconciles with the target

subject: infra.connect
name: Exchange-point peering traffic volume
what_would_settle_it: The exchange point's own annual report or a digital agency statement of aggregate exchanged traffic; the first-year assembly published none

subject: infra.connect
name: Retail price of internet access
what_would_settle_it: A regulator tariff observatory or operator price schedule; only the satellite operator's July 2025 grid is held, and no mobile data price for Chad exists at any date

subject: infra.connect
name: Wholesale international capacity price
what_would_settle_it: A transit contract with the neighbouring incumbent, or that incumbent's published wholesale price list; a named analyst asserts it is a large share of the retail price without giving a figure

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National computer emergency response team
what_would_settle_it: The establishing instrument or a security-agency statement naming an operational incident-response team; the agency's reform ordinance is described in trade press without one and its text is not held

subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity access rate and grid reliability
what_would_settle_it: A national utility annual report, the results framework of the regional electricity access operation, or published access data; the subject carries one source in the whole base

subject: infra.energy
name: Power arrangements for the data centre and telecom sites
what_would_settle_it: A site-power specification for the national data centre, or an operator statement of diesel and solar site counts and autonomy hours; the ministry's own June 2026 exchange shows fuel supply is the operative constraint and no numbers exist

subject: infra.capacity
name: Information technology workforce and regulator technical staffing
what_would_settle_it: A digital agency or regulator staffing statement, or the national digital skills plan under the connectivity strategy; the subject carries a single source, a police equipment donation

subject: dpi.id
name: National identification enrolment total and coverage rate
what_would_settle_it: An identity agency annual report or a published enrolment dashboard; the intersection page states plainly that no source in the base reports the register's enrolment total, and the system's 2020 deduplication capacity is a specification rather than a coverage figure

subject: dpi.id
name: Data-protection authority overseeing the biometric register
what_would_settle_it: The founding decree of a data-protection authority, or the security-agency reform ordinance confirming where supervision now sits; the reform folds data protection into the cyber agency with no standalone authority

subject: data.statistics
name: National statistics institute data publication
what_would_settle_it: Any dated statistical release from the national statistics institute; its site is unreachable from the wiki's network, so no national statistical output can be retrieved

subject: data.statistics
name: Census results
what_would_settle_it: The preliminary results release, the published methodology, or a post-enumeration survey plan; the base holds how the count was conducted and nothing about its output

subject: dpi.mis
name: National health management information system
what_would_settle_it: A health ministry statement or a national health-information implementation report; the base holds only exploratory talks with foreign suppliers and a private telehealth kiosk operator

subject: dpi.exchange
name: National interoperability and data-exchange layer
what_would_settle_it: The budget-framing text itself, or a digital or security agency technical specification naming the platform through which the mandated ministry interconnection is to run; the base holds the prohibition and no named exchange

subject: dpi.govtech
name: National citizen electronic-services portal
what_would_settle_it: A government portal address with a published service catalogue, or a digital agency statement of how many services are live online; the base records partially digitised procedures and nothing more concrete

subject: dpi.registry
name: Cadastre, state property and land registry platforms
what_would_settle_it: A finance or land-administration ministry statement, or an implementation report from either modernisation programme, saying whether these platforms exist and operate; they are named in the 2027 orientations as things to interconnect

subject: dpi.registry
name: National business register and one-stop shop
what_would_settle_it: The founding text or annual report of Chad's business one-stop shops, or an investment agency statement; a continental bank programme funds their modernisation and interconnection, which implies they exist, but the base holds no dated position

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural connectivity programme for the unserved localities
what_would_settle_it: A regulator or digital agency universal-service report giving the fund's balance and disbursements; the base holds about 500 unserved localities as a stated challenge with no financing instrument attached

subject: digital.localgov
name: Local-government digital services beyond the capital
what_would_settle_it: A territorial administration ministry statement on communal digital services, or an identity agency list of municipalities connected to the biometric system; only the capital's civil-registry interoperability work is on file

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime law
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted text with its number and promulgation date; the media regulator names it as the operative instrument for platform offences, so without it the wiki cannot say what conduct is criminalised or by whom it is enforced

subject: gov.discourse
name: Founding instrument and mandate of the media regulator
what_would_settle_it: The organic law or decree establishing the authority and defining its competences, which would show whether its disclaimer of jurisdiction over digital platforms is a reading of its statute or a policy choice

subject: gov.legislate
name: Founding instrument of the telecommunications regulator
what_would_settle_it: The statute or decree creating the regulator, with its independence guarantees, budget basis and sanction powers, plus a register of sanctions actually imposed

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal or policy
what_would_settle_it: Any national open-data policy, decree or portal address; the base holds no Chadian source on this subject, so the absence is currently inferred from silence rather than established

subject: data.open
name: Access-to-information statute
what_would_settle_it: The text of any Chadian access-to-information statute, or an authoritative statement that none exists

subject: gov.policy
name: Budget-framing instrument for 2027
what_would_settle_it: The ministry's own circular, which would date the orientations and allow provisions to be quoted at article level; the ministry site returned a server error at the last attempt

subject: geopol.eu
name: European digital-governance or regulatory-alignment instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any partnership, cooperation or programme document touching data governance or digital regulation; the four sources the base holds on this subject are training, data-centre financing and refugee identity projects, none carrying a governance instrument

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National artificial-intelligence strategy or policy
what_would_settle_it: A published national strategy or a Council of Ministers communique adopting one; nothing in the base suggests drafting has begun, so the finding may be that none exists

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Deployed or piloted artificial-intelligence system
what_would_settle_it: A digital agency or ministry procurement notice, or a security-agency register of systems under its new classification of entities of vital digital importance; no Chad-placed source describes a deployment

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: The national higher school of information and communication technologies
what_would_settle_it: The school's own institutional statement, enrolment figures or the ministry decree establishing it; it appears in the base only as a body India was asked to support

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: A signed memorandum, a joint communique, or any single dated Chad-Gulf digital event; the base has only mentions inside two lists of partners and no source at all on this subject

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Start-up statute, innovation fund or state innovation instrument
what_would_settle_it: A Chadian start-up law, a national innovation fund decree, or an employment or digital agency programme document that is not donor-financed; every innovation item in the base is donor-scaffolded

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Per-operator mobile market shares and subscriber bases
what_would_settle_it: A regulator annual market observatory, or operator segment disclosure for Chad; the base carries only a ministerial aggregate of beyond 13 million subscribers and no split

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Official sector statistics
what_would_settle_it: A regulator annual report or national accounts series giving the sector's contribution to gross domestic product, against which the assertion of 1.9 per cent could be checked; every sector figure in the base is trade press or ministerial statement

subject: finance.new
name: The 2019 framework agreement and the concessional loan agreement
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted ratification instrument of August 2019 and the loan contract; without them the EUR 175.1m, US$180m and FCFA 111.4bn figures cannot be reconciled to a document

subject: finance.budget
name: Domestic appropriation for digital technology
what_would_settle_it: The finance law and the 2027 framing circular, or any ministry budget annex showing a digital line; the base carries no Chadian budget figure for digital at all and the compiled budget outputs hold no Chad file

subject: include.access
name: Universal service fund
what_would_settle_it: The decree or article establishing a universal-service fund, or a regulator annual report confirming its absence, plus any levy rate and disbursement record

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: The component document or results framework of the transformation project naming the financial and digital literacy programmes it promises, with target numbers and a start date

subject: include.divides
name: Rural and urban split of internet access
what_would_settle_it: A regulator market observatory, the census household module on information technology ownership, or an international country profile with disaggregated access; the census now in the field is the obvious candidate

subject: include.access
name: Cost of connectivity
what_would_settle_it: A regulator tariff observatory or an affordability basket for Chad; the base holds only the satellite operator's own price card
